incidents.name: Sign in with Google temporarily disabled
incidents.message: Sign in with Google has been restored. We have updated our services to accommodate changes in the API response returned from Google

incidents.name: HTTPS proxy EU degraded performance
incidents.message: An issue with our HTTPS proxy in the EU region has been resolved. Our service hit API limits when attempting to re-provisioning a secure certificate for an existing custom domain. The issue has been identified and future occurrences of this issue will be prevented.

incidents.name: Enterprise database read-replica lag
incidents.message: Resolved - One of our Enterprise database read-replica's was experiencing replication issues and has been solved.

incidents.name: Enterprise database replication lag
incidents.message: One of our Enterprise database read-replica's was experiencing replication issues and has been solved.

incidents.name: Issue with Chat
incidents.message: Everything looks to be back to normal with Teamwork Chat, sorry if you were effected.

incidents.name: Single Sign On (SSO) US Region
incidents.message: Our Single Sign On (SSO) service in the US region experienced a failure and failed over to a new instance. Single Sign On is available again in the US region.

incidents.name: Investigating Access Denied issue in Teamwork Projects Dashboard
incidents.message: This issue is now resolved. A deployment to our EU Single Sign On (SSO) service redirected traffic temporarily and has now been restored.
